the R-group of a unitary unirramified genuine principal representation of a covering groups is isomorphic to the quotient of a subgroup of the Weyl group of the covering group by a subgroup of the corresponding R-group of the base group, and that the dimension of the R-group of the covering group is related to the dimension of its Whittaker space.

the R-groups for unitary unramifed genuine representations are related to the dimension of Whittaker spaces for the irreducible genuine constituents, and that a conjecture relating the R-group and the dimension of Whitterker spaces holds true for some saturated covers of the sympletic groups.

we prove the formula for the R-groups of unitary principal series representations of the covering group of a connected reductive group, we propose a conjectural formula relating the dimension of the associated Whittaker space to the R-group for saturated covers of simply connected semisimple groups, and we verify our conjecture in several cases.

we provide a new method to compute the R-groups for certain unitary genuine representations of covering groups.
